summary: Replace twelve placeholder examples with values DSM accepts, including the JSON-array form `files stat --path` requires.
reason: The generated examples carried `example-resource` and `example-value` throughout. `files stat --path` in particular takes a JSON array of paths rather than a bare path, so its example failed the client-side JSON check before a request was ever built; the five mutating File Station commands had the same problem on `--path`, `--folder-path` and `--name`. An example that cannot run is worse than no example, because dogfood counts it as covered.
